## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Impact

Describe any API, persistence, migration, security or compatibility impact.

## Testing

List the local commands and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] Public contracts and documentation were updated where necessary.
- [ ] Financial and security failure paths remain covered.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, internal conversations or tool logs are included.
